title: Personal Care Inclusions and Per-Use Prices — Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement
content:
The Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement includes a growing share of personal care as the care level rises. The table below sets out, for every care level, what the care fee includes and what a service beyond the inclusion costs (US dollars).

| Personal care item | Level 1 | Level 2 | Level 3 | Level 4 | Level 5 | Level 6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Incontinence care assistance included | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Incontinence care fee where not included, per month | 385.00 | 385.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Escorts to meals and activities included | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Escort assistance fee where not included, per month | 295.00 | 295.00 | 295.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Bathing or shower assists included per calendar week (Sunday to Saturday) | 1 | 2 | 2 | 3 | 5 | 7 |
| Each further bath assist in that week | 35.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 |
| Meal trays delivered to the apartment included per calendar month | 0 | 0 | 4 | 8 | 12 | 30 |
| Each further meal tray | 7.50 | 7.50 | 7.50 | 7.50 | 7.50 | 7.50 |

### Questions on the inclusions

**How is the bath-assist allowance counted?** Per calendar week, Sunday through Saturday: the count starts again each Sunday.

**What does a resident at Assisted Living Care Level 2 pay for a third bath assist in one week?** Two assists are included in that week, so the third is a further assist at 35.00 (hypothetical example).

**What does a resident at Assisted Living Care Level 4 pay for the ninth tray in a calendar month?** Eight trays are included in the month, so the ninth is a further tray at 7.50 (hypothetical example).
